notes: §2002:12.3.4.12.3 GR3: the key's data description and relative location within a record are those the file was created with. The key is registered at its byte window in the record (RecordLayout.KeyWindowOf, with the occurrence a subscripted K(2) selects, OccurrenceDisplacement), and the external-file identity compares that location. The golden writes a file by K(2), closes and reopens it, and reads it back by the same key (kb/Work PB5602).
